question: Do the frozen anomalous-Floquet sources supply the exact object, matched resources, operational task delta, and strongest completion rival required to admit the remaining P2C-2 source-grounded transition candidate?

representation_forks.detail: At the ideal bulk point U(T)=I permits H_F=0, which omits the within-period winding path and open-edge permutation.
The path U(k,t) carries the winding information.
A static Hamiltonian in one extra synthetic dimension spans the micromotion parameter, so an unqualified no-static-representative claim is not licensed.

tests: Verify exact periodic bulk identity for multiple finite lattice sizes.
Verify a bijective nontrivial open-boundary permutation whose moved sites are boundary sites.
Verify reversed step order gives the inverse permutation without changing admission completeness.
Reject admission while any required matched-resource or operational-task field is missing.
falsifiers: The ideal four-step map is not identity on a periodic bulk.
The open-boundary map is not a bijection or moves an interior site.
A source-frozen static comparator supplies a common physical power, noise/error, control, initialization, measurement, and task budget.
The synthetic-dimension completion does not represent the full micromotion object under its stated assumptions.
nonclaims: This receiver admission test does not refute anomalous Floquet topology or the cited experiments.
It does not establish or deny capability, issuance, finality, universality, source truth, canon, or public posture.
It does not claim every anomalous-Floquet construction has the same missing comparison fields.
reopening_conditions: Reopen on one source-grounded construction that freezes a matched static comparator with common drive power, bandwidth, duration, initialization, measurement, control, noise/error, and an operational task-set relation.
Reopen the representation verdict if a stronger completion rival invalidates either the fixed-phase or synthetic-dimension branch.
